notes.title: Froggonit development update
notes.content: [p]I just wanted to announce that I am 100% committed to releasing FROGGONIT this year.[/p][p]Hopefully around November / December.[/p][p]I'm focusing on the Steam version first and then I'll start working on the Switch version.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm working on the Raccoon Express 🚂 where you'll have to solve different things for your animal friends![/p][p][/p][p]📚Added a library car[/p][previewyoutube="6xJmfW7ESFA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]🍕And a dining car:[/p][previewyoutube="J34BEc3eoDQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Next steps[/b]: I'll walk to the window and close it, it's cold in here![/p][p][b]DEVELOPMENT steps[/b]: Ohhh, I'm going to work on finishing all the different cars for the train.[/p][p]I think that development is going very well and the game feels great! In every corner there is some object or animal to interact with. Or dance.[/p][p][/p][p]If you liked Restless Soul, I think you're going to love Froggonit! If feels more... alive 👻[/p][p]If you didn't like Restless Soul, you are going to like Froggonit too.[/p][p]If you don't know what Restless Soul is, don't worry, I don't know either.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates and I'll see you... in the next video![/p][p]Wait, this wasn't a video.[/p]
